title: Daily check
hint: 30 seconds. There are no right or wrong answers.

onGoal.q: Were you in line with your goal today?

urges.q: How many strong urges did you have?

value.q: Something you did today in line with your values (optional)
value.placeholder: Example: I went for an evening walk.

done: Thank you. Noticing yourself is the foundation of change.
doneSlip: Thank you for your honest answer. If you like, let's look at it together; it's a chance to learn.
lowMood: You've been feeling very low for the last few days. You don't have to carry this alone.
